LightningComponentBundle.description: Search-style prompt bar for Experience sites. Opens the page hosting Fin Card Chat and asks Fin the typed or suggested question on arrival.

property.name: placeholder
property.label: Placeholder
property.default: Ask Fin about products, plans, or your account

property.name: suggestions
property.label: Suggested questions
property.description: Separate with semicolons. Up to 6 show under the bar. Leave blank to hide.
property.default: Compare plans; Track my order; Start a return; Talk to a person

property.name: chatPagePath
property.label: Chat page URL
property.description: URL of the site page hosting Fin Card Chat, without the site prefix (for example ask-fin).
